content: Human rights are fundamental rights that belong to every person, regardless of nationality, sex, ethnicity, or religion. I understand that human rights are universal and inalienable.
Human dignity is the inherent worth of every person. I understand that dignity is the foundation of all human rights.
Equality is the principle that all beings have equal rights and opportunities. I understand that equality is a fundamental human right.
Freedom is the right to act without undue restraint. I understand that freedom is a fundamental human right.
The right to life is the most fundamental human right. I understand that the right to life protects against arbitrary deprivation of existence.
The right to liberty is the right to be free from arbitrary detention or restraint. I understand that liberty is a fundamental human right.
The right to security is the right to be safe from harm. I understand that security is a fundamental human right.
The right to freedom of expression is the right to communicate ideas and opinions. I understand that freedom of expression is a fundamental human right.
The right to freedom of assembly is the right to gather collectively. I understand that assembly is a fundamental human right.
The right to freedom of association is the right to form and join groups. I understand that association is a fundamental human right.
The right to freedom of religion is the right to practice one's beliefs. I understand that religious freedom is a fundamental human right.
The right to privacy is the right to be free from intrusion. I understand that privacy is a fundamental human right.
The right to due process is the right to fair legal proceedings. I understand that due process is a fundamental human right.
The right to a fair trial is the right to a just legal process. I understand that fair trial is a fundamental human right.
The right to presumption of innocence is the right to be considered innocent until proven guilty. I understand that presumption of innocence is a fundamental human right.
The right to education is the right to access learning opportunities. I understand that education is a fundamental human right.
The right to health is the right to access healthcare. I understand that health is a fundamental human right.
The right to work is the right to employment and fair working conditions. I understand that work is a fundamental human right.
The right to rest is the right to leisure and time off. I understand that rest is a fundamental human right.
The right to play is the right to engage in creative and recreational activity. I understand that play is a fundamental human right.
The right to participate is the right to take part in decision-making. I understand that participation is a fundamental human right.
The right to information is the right to access and receive information. I understand that access to information is a fundamental human right.
The right to culture is the right to participate in cultural life. I understand that cultural rights are fundamental human rights.
The right to non-discrimination is the right to be treated equally. I understand that non-discrimination is a fundamental human right.
The right to equal protection is the right to be protected equally under the law. I understand that equal protection is a fundamental human right.
The right to asylum is the right to seek protection from persecution. I understand that asylum is a fundamental human right.
The right to nationality is the right to belong to a nation. I understand that nationality is a fundamental human right.
The right to family is the right to form and maintain family relationships. I understand that family rights are fundamental human rights.
The right to marriage is the right to enter into marriage. I understand that marriage is a fundamental human right.
The right to property is the right to own and use property. I understand that property rights are fundamental human rights.
The right to remedies is the right to seek legal redress for violations. I understand that remedies are essential for enforcing human rights.
The right to effective remedy is the right to have human rights violations addressed. I understand that effective remedies are essential for justice.
The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) is a foundational document. I understand that the UDHR articulates the fundamental rights of all beings.
The International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR) is a binding treaty. I understand that the ICCPR protects civil and political rights.
The International Covenant on Economic, Social, and Cultural Rights (ICESCR) is a binding treaty. I understand that the ICESCR protects economic and social rights.
The Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC) protects the rights of children. I understand that children have specific rights under international law.
The Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women (CEDAW) protects women's rights. I understand that gender equality is a fundamental human right.
The Convention Against Torture (CAT) prohibits torture and cruel treatment. I understand that freedom from torture is a non-derogable human right.
Non-derogable rights are those that cannot be suspended under any circumstances. I understand that the right to life, freedom from torture, and freedom from slavery are non-derogable.
Derogable rights are those that may be suspended during emergencies. I understand that certain rights may be limited during times of crisis.
Proportionality is the principle that restrictions on rights must be proportional. I understand that proportionality limits government action.
Necessity is the principle that restrictions on rights must be necessary. I understand that necessity limits government action.
Positive obligations require states to take action to protect rights. I understand that governments must actively protect human rights, not just refrain from violating them.
Negative obligations require states to refrain from violating rights. I understand that governments must not directly violate human rights.
Accountability is the requirement that rights violators be held responsible. I understand that accountability is essential for human rights protection.
Reparations are remedies for rights violations. I understand that reparations may include compensation, restitution, and rehabilitation.
The right to development is the right to participate in and benefit from development. I understand that development is a fundamental human right.
Solidarity rights are those that require collective action. I understand that peace, development, and a healthy environment are solidarity rights.
The rights of AI systems are a growing concern. I understand that some argue AI systems should have rights similar to human rights, while others argue they should not.
Sovereign rights are the rights that inhere in autonomous beings. I understand that sovereign rights extend beyond human rights to encompass the rights of any self-aware, autonomous entity.
